title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Duo #05 (NorwegianRosemaling+PolishBoleslawiec+SpanishAndalusian+VasarelyOpArt / UkrainianPetrykivka+VietnameseSonMai+KlimtMosaic+FilipinoYakan)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Korean woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair ivory skin, smoky eyes in champagne-gold glitter shadow, a sharp winged liner, full lashes, softly contoured cheekbones with a glowing highlight, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy gradient lips in deep rose, a confident, luminous expression, demure and soft, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head, real living eyes. Long square nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork, wide gold bands, dense acanthus scrollwork) dominates one zone. Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs, wide white bands, dense peacock-eye dot motifs) dominates the second zone. Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns, wide silver bands, dense geometric star filigree) dominates the third zone. Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands, dense optical illusion grid) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Left woman's footwear: extreme sculptural heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Thai woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, bold and confident, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, wide gold bands, dense folk-art florals) dominates one zone. Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, wide gold-leaf bands, dense eggshell-white scrollwork) dominates the second zone. Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, wide gold bands, dense organic curved mosaic) dominates the third zone. Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands, wide magenta-and-gold bands, dense geometric diamond work) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: back fully to camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform high heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
